title: We Choose Agni as Messenger
translation: We choose Agni as our messenger, the invoker who knows all, the wise performer of this sacrifice.
translation_hi: हम अग्नि को अपना दूत चुनते हैं, जो सर्वज्ञ होता हैं और इस यज्ञ को उत्तम रीति से करने वाले हैं।
science: Fire as 'messenger' to the sky: smoke and heat rise because hot air is less dense than the cool air around it, carrying the offering upward.
